subject: *: fix index lookup pushdown error for partition table + uncomitted rows (#65157)
summary: Planner-only change: `buildPushDownIndexLookUpPlan` now locates the int-handle column by scanning backwards and skipping trailing negative-ID “extra” columns (e.g. `model.ExtraPhysTblID`), instead of assuming the last schema column is the handle (`pkg/planner/core/operator/physicalop/physical_indexlookup.go:48`). This matches `PhysicalIndexScan.InitSchema` behavior where `ExtraPhysTblID` can be appended after the handle for partition/dynamic-prune/UnionScan cases (`pkg/planner/core/operator/physicalop/physical_index_scan.go:397`), preventing wrong `IndexHandleOffsets` and the resulting pushdown runtime errors; no follow-up changes to this logic found up to `upstream/master`.
